scripts.local:up: docker compose up --build -d && npm run local:ps
scripts.local:rebuild: docker compose build --no-cache && docker compose up -d
scripts.local:health: curl -sf http://localhost:3000/api/configuration/version >/dev/null && echo 'server :3000 OK' || echo 'server :3000 DOWN'; curl -sf http://localhost:4200 >/dev/null && echo 'client :4200 OK' || echo 'client :4200 DOWN'
